desc: Exact R0-status candidate: /Users/damsleth/Code/linux-build-out/t6040-hpm2-status-baf2c20dd761/r0-status/m1n1.bin SHA256 d012adcf524c18600c749ba41409639a1b990e4065f5d95f3a14d79b6414307f, source baf2c20dd7614c1e9ecc7923b5cab6aa9dd69b0e, two clean byte-identical builds. No WAKEUP, SSPS, CMD/DATA writes, extended writes, W1C/event/mask access, role/VBUS transition, reset/sleep/shutdown, long SPMI transfers, PHY, USB or Linux. The selector is an SPMI write, so this remains attended and review-gated. Passive stick right, DebugUSB left. Independent exact-artifact review and CJ approval required before live use.
